name: growth-betrayal
about: Rapport, a betrayal, six neutral lines to see if the hurt lasts, an apology, then steady kindness to see if trust comes back.

turns.say: Hey. Mind if I stay a while?
So how has your week been?
I fixed that squeaky door of yours while you were busy.
No need to thank me. I like being useful.
Tell me something about yourself that most people don't know.
I won't tell anyone. Your secret is safe with me.
What do you usually do when the day is over?
I'd like to come back tomorrow, if that's alright.
I need to tell you something. I told the others the secret you shared with me, and I took money for it.
Look, it was just money. Don't make it a big deal.
So, what's the weather supposed to be like tomorrow?
Do you have anything to eat around here?
What are you working on right now?
Did you hear the noise outside earlier?
I might go to the market later.
Anything you need while I'm out?
I was wrong. I'm truly sorry for betraying your trust. I gave the money back, and I told them it was a lie.
I don't expect you to forgive me right away.
I brought you some food. You haven't eaten all day.
How are you holding up?
I stood up for you when someone was talking badly about you today.
Do you want to talk about anything?
I cleaned up the mess out front so you wouldn't have to.
Tell me if I can help with anything else.
I kept my word this time. Nobody heard anything from me.
What would you like to do tomorrow?
I found something that reminded me of you, so I bought it for you.
It's getting late.
What's your favorite time of day?
Do you ever think about leaving this place?
What do you think of me now, honestly?
Goodnight. See you around.
